opening.argument: The speaker directly recommends purchasing a Forsage level with TRX, stating, "we should buy a level of 50-70 tx." The displayed Forsage X4 interface presents paid level options with an Activate control and refers to reinvesting the level and having partners at each level. Alongside the title "Online Earning Guru," these features frame level purchases and upgrades as an online-earning opportunity dependent on partners and recruitment, rather than as a neutral technical demonstration.
